summary: Proposal Phase 1 — Task 6b-1. Extends the WORKING System A deadline engine (public.calculate_deadline) with two additive per-period filing-type arms — 'mtd_quarter' (fixed statutory MTD-ITSA quarterly update date: the 7th of the month after each standard 5th-ending quarter-end, i.e. 5 Jul→7 Aug / 5 Oct→7 Nov / 5 Jan→7 Feb / 5 Apr→7 May) and 'mtd_itsa_final' (31 January following the tax year, mirroring the self_assessment arm's year logic) — every other arm reproduced byte-for-byte from the live body. Also adds a per-org 'mtd_quarter' catalog service (MTD Quarterly Filing, entity_scope='individual', canonical_service_code='self_assessment_mtd_quarterly'), one row per org that has sa_mtd, copying that org's NOT-NULL columns — mirroring Task 6a (20260725130000). System B (lifecycle_generate_deadlines_for_job + canonical_deadline_rules) is left dormant; nothing is routed into it.

problem.context: The proposal now creates one job per compliance period (per SA year, per accounts period, per VAT period, and — for MTD — per quarter + annual + SA). Once a job carries its own exact period its deadline is simple date-math on that one period, so System A only needs two tiny additive arms to cover the new MTD-quarter and MTD-final job types (design note docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-25-proposal-t6b-deadline-engine-note.md, Option A). Activating System B was rejected as disproportionate/regression-prone for this release.
problem.scope: Additive only. CREATE OR REPLACE of calculate_deadline (live body verbatim + two new CASE arms + a header comment marking System A as the active engine); one guarded per-org services_catalog INSERT (NOT EXISTS on (organization_id, code)). No existing arm, function signature, table, or row is altered or dropped. lifecycle_materialize_jobs, UI, and System B are untouched.

post_apply_followups: Signature note: the live/git calculate_deadline uses UNPREFIXED parameter names (filing_type, period_start, period_end, metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}') — NOT the p_-prefixed names assumed in the task brief. The new arms therefore reference period_end (not p_period_end). When verifying via db_rpc, pass args keyed as filing_type/period_start/period_end/metadata.

mtd_itsa_final year logic: uses make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM period_end)::int + 1, 1, 31), which yields 31 Jan (year+1) for the canonical 5-April tax-year end — identical to the self_assessment arm's DATE_TRUNC('year', period_end)+1yr+1mo-1day result (whose <4-month guard never fires for a 5-Apr period_end). Confirmed equal for the receipted input.

Canonical binding: mtd_quarter reuses the canonical concept 'self_assessment_mtd_quarterly' per the T6b design note; the legacy orphaned services_catalog 'mtd_quarterly' row is intentionally left untouched (not renamed/deleted).
